title: selaginella cuspidata
intro: Selaginella cuspidata, commonly known as the spiny spike moss, is a type of fern-like plant that belongs to the family Selaginellaceae. It is a non-vascular plant, which means it lacks a true vascular system for transporting water and nutrients. The plant has been traditionally used in various cultures to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, and is believed to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Selaginella cuspidata include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
